Mark Twain, Personal Recollections of Joan of Arc.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/mark-twain/personal-recollections-of-joan-of-arc

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Mark Twain, the author, died 1910.

First publication of the text used: 1896 (SE colophon: 'Personal Recollections of Joan of Arc was published in 1896 by Mark Twain.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1896, before 1931, so the United States rule for works published before 1931 applies. The edition's rights statement below also states the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (the last to die did so in 1910), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
